jobs.description:
Do you have experience as a supervisor? Are you looking for a responsible job? Are you able to optimize day-to-day activities while minimizing costs? Then we are looking for you!

What are you going to do?
- Organize workflow by assigning responsibilities and preparing schedules
- Responsible for scheduling control
- Maintain material control and quality control
- Responsible for other duties on assembly line
- Oversee and coach employees
- Identify issues in efficiency and suggest improvements
- Enforce strict safety guidelines and company standards.

What do we offer?
In addition to a competitive and negotiable salary, we offer:

- weekly payment of this salary,
- 8% holiday allowance and 25 days of leave (on a full-time basis),
- participation in the pension scheme from day 1, and
- personal development. During your contract you have access to the Adecco Academy, an online platform with various training and courses.

Where will you work?
Our client is an employer that offers equal opportunities for everyone and embraces diversity in the employee population. Our client is a world leader in IT products. The servers are built in Den Bosch, where they have their own production department.

You often work together with (international) colleagues. They communicate with each other in English or Dutch.

What do we ask?
- High School degree, college degree preferred
- Minimum 5+ years of relative working experience in electronic or computer industry preferred
- Solid understanding of computer system assembly
- Possess basic mechanical knowledge
- Familiarity with computer or electronic components testing and inspection
- Experience with mechanical assembly, cable routing, and quality standards
- Strong attention to detail, including accuracy and thoroughness
- Ability to comprehend spoken and written English
- Ability to work overtime and weekends depending on business demands.

Are you interested?
Apply quickly via the application button!

Want more information? Co

As an Assembly & Repair Technician, you work in a modern production environment. Together with 6 to 8 colleagues per shift, you make sure technical parts are assembled, checked and prepared for shipment.

Your tasks include:

- Assembling technical parts according to drawings and work instructions
- Repairing and checking plastic, metal and wooden parts
- Packing fragile parts in large crates for international transport
- Carrying out quality checks during and after the work
- Working with heavier tools, such as a column drill or wall saw
- Reporting defects or deviations to your supervisor
- Keeping your workplace clean and safe

You work full-time in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 to 15:00
- Afternoon/evening shift: 15:00 to 00:00

You receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

- For this role, we ask:- You are available full-time for a 2-shift schedule
- You live in the Eindhoven, Veldhoven, Best or Helmond region
- You have experience in technical work, assembly or repair
- You can work with heavier tools, such as a column drill or wall saw
- You can read technical drawings and follow work instructions
- You have a good command of English, both spoken and written
- Experience with accurate and independent working is a plus

As a demolition worker, you are responsible for carrying out demolition and clean-up activities safely and efficiently. Experience is not required; motivation and a practical attitude are most important.

Your tasks include:

- Demolishing walls, floors and other constructions using hand tools and small machinery
- Cleaning and removing debris from demolition sites
- Separating construction waste and materials according to safety regulations
- Assisting colleagues during renovation and demolition projects
- Loading and unloading materials and tools
- Following VGM and safety instructions on-site
- Keeping the workplace clean and organised

You work in a 2-shift schedule:

- Early shift: Monday to Friday from 06:00 to 15:00
- Late shift: Monday to Friday from 15:00 to 00:00

You receive an 18% shift allowance on top of your salary.

For this position, it is important that you enjoy physical work and can work safely on construction and demolition sites.

We ask the following:

- You have an active and practical working attitude
- You are physically fit and able to perform heavy work
- You are willing to work in a 2-shift schedule
- You understand basic safety and VGM instructions
- You can work both independently and in a team
- A driver's license B is an advantage
- You have a good command of the English language

Do you enjoy taking control and ensuring everything runs smoothly? As a Print Production Worker, you'll be responsible for delivering print materials in perfect condition to our clients. From bundling and packing to cutting and folding, you'll tackle the work with enthusiasm.

Responsibilities:

- Bundling and packing print materials
- Cutting flyers, brochures, and folders
- Creating stapled brochures
- Folding various types of folders

- Good command of the English language
- Able to work both independently and as part of a team
- Living in the Etten-Leur area
- Own transport
- Available to work in 3shift system

As a logistics employee, you play an important role in the warehouse and distribution process. You make sure goods are handled safely, correctly and on time.

Your tasks are:

- Loading and unloading trucks.
- Packing, sorting and labelling products.
- Preparing orders and processing returns.
- Checking the quality and quantity of goods.
- Registering your work in the system.
- Solving small deviations and keeping the warehouse tidy.
- Moving goods with an EPT and sometimes with a forklift.

You work from Monday to Friday in 2 shifts. One week you work from 06:00 to 15:00. The other week you work from 15:00 to 00:00.

- You speak and understand English.
- You have experience in logistics.
- You enjoy working in a logistics environment.
- You are willing to work in 2 shifts.
- You have an EPT or forklift certificate, or you are willing to obtain one.
- You live in or near Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel or Valkenswaard.

As a Cleanroom Operator, you play an important role in maintaining the quality of high-tech products used in industries such as semiconductors and electronics. You will work in a controlled cleanroom environment where accuracy, safety, and quality are essential.

Your daily tasks include:

- Cleaning high-tech components according to cleanroom procedures and work instructions.
- Performing assembly work using hand tools and technical drawings.
- Inspecting products and carrying out quality measurements.
- Preparing and cleaning metal frames and packaging materials according to protocol.
- Reporting deviations and registering quality findings in the production system.
- Reading and following technical drawings and work instructions accurately.
- Keeping your workplace clean, safe, and organized according to cleanroom standards.

Working hours

You will work from Monday to Friday in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 – 15:00
- Evening shift: 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts. Overtime on Saturdays or Sundays is paid at 150% when applicable.

Required

- Good command of the English language.
- Ability to read technical drawings and work instructions.
- Technical insight or experience within a production environment.
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule.
- Living in or within travelling distance of Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, or Valkenswaard.

Preferred

- Experience working in a cleanroom environment.
- Experience with assembly work or high-tech production.

Are you looking for a logistics job with the chance of a permanent contract? Do you want to receive your salary every week? Are you physically strong and enjoy active work? If so, keep reading – this could be the right job for you!

What are you going to do?
As a warehouse employee in the Shipping team you are responsible for order picking, packing and picking of products, maintaining the warehouse and keeping track of inventory. The work instructions are in English, you follow them as correctly as possible. In addition, you are a team player and willing to support other teams when necessary. Together with your team you ensure that you meet the daily demand and quality. This is a full-time job, you will work from Monday to Friday starting at 09.00 AM until 17.30 PM. 

What do we offer?
In addition to an attractive salary starting at €2,650 gross per month, we offer:

- Weekly salary payments.
- 8% vacation allowance and 25 vacation days (full-time).
- Travel allowance.
- Participation in the pension fund from day one.
- Personal development opportunities via access to the Adecco Academy, an online platform with various training and courses.

Where will you work?
Super Micro is a world leader in IT products. The servers are built in Den Bosch, where they have their own production department. After the production of the servers, they need to be shipped on time. ? Besides a nice salary, you will be compensated for your travel expenses. When the client is satisfied with you, and you with them, it is possible to get a permanent contract. Besides that you have a lot of (international) colleagues to work with.

What do we ask?
- You switch quickly between different work activities;
- You work well under pressure and with deadlines;
- You speak and write excellent English;
- In addition, you are resourceful, driven, accurate and a real team player. 

Are you interested?
Apply quickly via the application button!

Want more information? Contact Layla Venn at 06 43446012

As a Maintenance Employee, you will work on maintaining and repairing packaging for fragile high-tech components. You will follow clear instructions and work together with colleagues to ensure a safe and efficient production process.

Your tasks include:

- Repairing and inspecting packaging according to checklists and work instructions
- Performing preventive maintenance on packaging materials
- Working with hand tools and technical equipment
- Identifying and reporting deviations during the production process
- Registering repairs and inspections in the system
- Loading, unloading, and transporting materials with an EPT or forklift
- Collaborating with colleagues to maintain quality and safety standards

You will work in a 2-shift schedule:

- Week 1: 06:00 – 15:00
- Week 2: 15:00 – 00:00

The shifts alternate weekly.

During your onboarding period, you will receive extensive training and guidance to become familiar with the tasks and tools required for the role.

- Technical insight and a practical working attitude
- Experience with maintenance work and reading technical drawings
- Experience using hand tools and operating an EPT or forklift
- Forklift certificate is preferred or can be obtained through WerkTalent
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Good command of the English language (minimum B1 level)
- Accurate and independent working attitude

As a Cleanroom Operator, you are responsible for cleaning, inspecting, and preparing technical components used in industries such as semiconductors, aerospace, and medical technology. You will work according to strict cleanroom procedures and ensure every product meets the required quality standards.

Your responsibilities include:

- Cleaning technical components and packaging materials according to cleanroom protocols.
- Performing visual inspections and quality checks on finished products.
- Assembling and packaging products according to work instructions.
- Reading and following technical drawings and production instructions.
- Registering and reporting deviations during the production process.
- Refilling cleaning materials and maintaining the required stock levels.
- Keeping the cleanroom and your workstation clean, safe, and organized.

You will work in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 – 15:00
- Afternoon shift: 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

- Experience in a production or cleanroom environment
- Technical insight and the ability to read technical drawings and work instructions.
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule.
- Good command of the English language.
- Structured, accurate, and independent working attitude.
- Living in the Eindhoven region or willing to travel

Would you like to work as a Production Operator in Hapert on a day shift? Learn the job in practice and earn €16.52 gross per hour. Apply today!

What are you going to do?
- Preparing materials and production moulds
- Applying fiberglass to components
- Filling and pressing moulds according to work instructions
- Sanding, spraying, and finishing products
- Performing quality checks on finished products
- Identifying deviations and contributing ideas for improvements
- Working closely with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process

What do we offer?
You will join a pleasant working environment where craftsmanship, development, and teamwork are central.

- Salary of €16.52 gross per hour
- Full-time day shift position (07:30 AM – 04:30 PM)
- 27 vacation days based on full-time employment
- 8% holiday allowance
- Pension accrual from your first working day
- Access to the Adecco Academy with more than 150 online training courses
- Working in a modern, safe, and clean production environment

Where will you work?
You will be working for an innovative manufacturing company in Hapert, near Eindhoven and the Kempen region. The company develops and produces strong, lightweight composite products for various industries. Quality, innovation, and safety are key priorities.

The atmosphere is informal and friendly. Colleagues support each other and work together to achieve the best results. You will work in a modern factory where all necessary personal protective equipment is provided.

What do we ask?
- You are available full-time
- You can perform physical work
- You like working in a production environment
- You speak English
- You are able to work with fiberglass and chemical substances
- You are able to obtain a Certificate of Conduct (VOG)

Are you interested?
Does this sound like the opportunity you are looking for? Apply directly via the application button before 9 August 2026.

For more information about the position or the company, please contact us at +31 40

jobs.description:
Join our team as a Warehouse Worker/Forklift Driver! 

At our family-owned company, we handle raw materials like s​eeds, spices, and legumes. You'll work in two locations: Moerkapelle and Waddinxveen. 

Key tasks:

- Driving hef- and reachtruck 
-  Loading & unloading with EPT
-  Order picking
-  Preparing orders

We believe in strong teamwork, flexibility, and open communication. And don't worry, there's always room for a joke! 😄

Your will work in a day shift from 06:00 or 07:00 to 16:00 from Monday to Friday. You don’t have to work in the weekend!

- Living in the area of Rotterdam, The Hague, Zoetermeer, Waddinxveen, Gouda, Zoetermeer, Bleiswijk or Region Zuidplas and surroundings.
- Fulltime available from Monday to Friday.
- Experience in logistics or you would like to learn more in this field.
- In possession of a forklift and/or reach truck certificate or willing to obtain these through us.
- You are fluent in Dutch or English.
- In possession of a car and driving license B.

As an Allround Carpenter, you are responsible for assembling and repairing wooden packaging used to transport sensitive industrial components. You will work from technical drawings and follow clear work instructions to ensure every product meets the required quality standards.

Your daily responsibilities include:

- Disassembling and reassembling wooden transport crates.
- Reading technical drawings and following work instructions.
- Inspecting wooden components for quality and damage.
- Reporting production deviations and quality issues.
- Working safely with hand tools and power tools.
- Supporting colleagues within the woodworking department.
- Keeping your workplace clean, safe, and organized.

You will work in a 2-shift schedule:

- Monday to Friday: 06:00 – 15:00
- Monday to Friday: 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

- mbo working and thinking level.
- Experience with woodworking or assembly work.
- Ability to read technical drawings.
- Technical insight and a hands-on mentality.
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule.
- Good command of the English language.
- Living in the Eindhoven region is a plus

jobs.occupation: Forklift Driver – Day Shift! €16.21 per hour- Bleiswijk (publications-199707-B)
jobs.description:
As an experienced forklift driver, you will work for a specialist in the fruit and vegetable (AGF) sector. With your precise way of working, you ensure that the right products end up in the right place. If you see a fellow forklift driver moving pallets, you will naturally lend a helping hand. Teamwork and collegiality are therefore highly valued within the company. For this position, it is important that you are comfortable working in a chilled environment of approximately 10°C.

Responsibilities:

- Carrying out quality checks in a correct and careful manner
- Moving and storing goods in the correct locations
- Working in a structured and safe way with the forklift

You will work weekdays from 06:30 to 16:00 (with possible overtime when required) and are expected to work one Saturday per month. Overtime worked above 38 hours per week is paid at 135% of the regular hourly rate.

- Experience as a forklift driver
- Good command of both Dutch and English
- Ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment
- Full-time availability and looking for a permanent position
- Own transportation
- Living in or around Rotterdam, The Hague, Zoetermeer, or Bleiswijk

For HQ Pack in Eindhoven, we are looking for technical and accurate employees who want to work in a cleanroom environment. Together with your colleagues, you will assemble and process high-tech products for international customers.

Your tasks include:

- Collecting products and processing data in the ERP system
- Assembling products based on technical drawings and work instructions
- Working with hand tools such as screwdrivers and assembly tools
- Cleaning, inspecting, and packaging high-tech components according to cleanroom guidelines
- Performing quality checks and verifying product specifications
- Identifying and reporting deviations during the production process
- Keeping the cleanroom and workplace clean and safe

You will work full-time in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 – 15:00
- Evening shift: 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

Must-haves

- vmbo/mbo working and thinking level
- Ability to read technical drawings
- Good command of the English language
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Accurate and structured working attitude

Preferred

- Experience in assembly, production, or cleanroom work
- Experience working with hand tools and technical assembly

As a Cleaning Operator, you will work in a high-tech production environment in Eindhoven, where industrial packaging and transport boxes are cleaned, inspected, and prepared for reuse. This is a full-time position in a 2-shift schedule within an international organization with long-term career opportunities.

Function Description

As a Cleaning Operator, you are responsible for cleaning and preparing high-tech packaging materials according to strict quality standards and work instructions. You play an important role in ensuring that industrial packaging is ready for safe worldwide transport.

Your daily responsibilities include:

- Cleaning industrial packaging and transport boxes according to work instructions.
- Removing labels, contamination, and transport damage from packaging.
- Cleaning and packing packaging materials and components.
- Working according to cleanroom and logistics procedures.
- Reading English checklists and technical work instructions.
- Reporting quality deviations and process irregularities.
- Operating an EPT (Electric Pallet Truck) or stacker.

You will work in a 2-shift schedule:

- Week 1: Monday to Friday, 06:00 – 15:00
- Week 2: Monday to Friday, 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance, which is included in the stated monthly salary.

Saturday work may occasionally be required in consultation. Hours worked on Saturdays are paid with a 50% allowance on top of your regular hourly wage.

Must-haves

- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule.
- Ability to read technical drawings and work instructions.
- Good command of the Dutch and/or English language.
- Affinity with cleaning and production work.
- Willingness to work occasional Saturdays when required.

Nice to have

- Experience as an assembly worker, production worker, or logistics employee.
- Experience operating an EPT or stacker.
- Living in or within easy travelling distance of Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel, or Valkenswaard.

Working with wood and machines is the core of this position. As a CNC Wood Operator, you are responsible for processing wood and sheet materials using modern CNC and planer machines.

Your tasks include:

- Setting up and operating CNC and planer machines
- Reading technical drawings and work orders
- Inspecting and measuring products according to quality standards
- Performing preventive maintenance on machines
- Changing and adjusting tools when needed
- Monitoring production output and tolerances
- Keeping the workplace and machines clean and organized

You will work in a 2-shift schedule with the following working hours:

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 15:00 – 00:00

- At least 1 year of experience as a CNC operator or machine operator
- Experience in woodworking is a plus
- Ability to read and understand technical drawings
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Good command of the Dutch or English language
- Accurate and independent working attitude
- Experience with forklift operations is a plus

As an operator, your main responsibility is to oversee the packaging of mangoes and avocados according to customer specifications. Subsequently, these yields are dispatched to supermarkets. Within this role, you will operate machinery and also supervise production staff working alongside you on the line. You will do this in English.

- Set up and adjust the net clipper or flowpack machines (performing light technical tasks).
- Supervise production workers.
- Ensure the smooth operation of the production line.
- Troubleshoot and resolve any issues that may arise.
- Perform administrative tasks on a computer to ensure all records and registrations are accurately maintained.
- Perform additional production tasks and maintain line cleanliness.

This is a full-time day shift position starting at 6:45 AM, concluding around 4:00 PM, with the possibility of extending hours for which you will receive a 135% overtime bonus after 38 hours worked per week. Weekends are off. However, it's important to note that the work environment is cold, with a temperature of 10 degrees Celsius, and you will be provided with appropriate warm clothing.

- Experience as an operator in an AGF environment, preferably with experience in using a net clipper or flowpack machine.
- Good command of the Dutch or English language.
- Leadership qualities.
- Full-time availability, preference for a permanent position.
- Own transportation is essential.
- Living near the Rotterdam, The Hague, Zoetermeer, Bleiswijk area.
